label: Finding-5
title: quarkslab-2024: Who found the OOM issue in 2024: the two sources differ
description: The claim says the issue 'was found in a 2024 audit by Quarkslab'. The Foundation, the primary party, says a PHP core developer found the first signs 'while fixing one of the issues Quarkslab reported'. timeline.json (at 2024) states the Foundation's version correctly; this claim does not. Quarkslab's published summary lists no OOM finding.
